description:
Dr. MIN Creates TAE-HA, SUN-WOO, and SUL-HYUN to protect his daughter, HEE-JEE. The 3 cyborgs to their best to take care of her... But they keep asking themselves if they are human. What fate awaits them?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020007627), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/contents?idx=8338), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/C000048491), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6318794), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/Cyborg), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/57351649), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H040357493), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H040357493)
